details.name: UV Protection
details.description: NOVAR lenses help reduce eye exposure to ultraviolet rays, providing added care and visual comfort during outdoor activities and sun exposure.

details.name: Blue Tech
details.description: NOVAR BLUE TECH combines reflective protection technology with in-mass absorption technology in a single lens to improve lens performance and inhibit blue-violet light that may cause AMD and long-term retinal damage.

details.name: Anti-scratch
details.description: This new, exclusive, state-of-the-art nanolayer technology protects ophthalmic lens surfaces from scratches, abrasions, and exposure to common household and industrial chemicals such as alcohol and solvents, which can seriously degrade lens surfaces.

details.name: Polarized
details.description: ADVENTRA is anti-glare technology that reduces reflections from surfaces. It is designed to improve contrast and reduce glare during outdoor activities.

details.name: Hydrophobic
details.description: Hydrophobic treatment is an advanced technology applied to lenses to repel water and keep it from adhering to the surface. It creates a protective layer that reduces water droplets, helping maintain clear vision in rain or humidity. It also helps keep lenses clean longer by making it harder for dust and dirt to adhere.

details.name: Photochromic
details.description: Additional technology helps lenses adapt to different environments as lighting changes. They remain clear indoors and darken when exposed to sunlight.

details.name: iLUX anti-reflective treatment
details.description: Anti-reflective treatment reduces distracting reflections on lens surfaces, improving visual clarity and appearance. It is suitable for people who work in front of screens, drive at night, or want clearer vision in different lighting conditions. It also reduces glare and improves light transmission for a more comfortable, relaxed visual experience.

comparison.name: Blue Tech
comparison.description: Reduces eye strain from blue light emitted by screens.

sophiaDescription: Talk to Sophia; she can help you combine treatments for your routine.
